#     - No two items covering the same SubConcept appear within proximity_window
#     - Equity floor met: >= 15% of items feature underrepresented scenarios
#     - Assembly is deterministic for the same blueprint + seed (reproducible)

#   claim:   Exam validity requires systematic content sampling aligned with a

#            — never silently produce a partial or unconstrained exam

## Summary
Build the greedy bin-pack exam assembly algorithm that selects assessment items from the approved pool to satisfy all blueprint constraints (Bloom distribution, USMLE proportions, difficulty bands, equity floor) while enforcing item proximity rules and the Three-Hub Invariant.

## User story
As a faculty member, I want to click "Assemble Exam" on a finalized blueprint and receive a valid exam with items automatically selected to match my specifications, so that I don't have to manually pick questions one by one.

## Why this matters
Manual item selection for a 50-question exam takes hours and invariably produces biased distributions. An incorrect assembly algorithm silently violates blueprint constraints, producing exams that don't test what they claim to test. Proximity violations (two questions on the same concept adjacent) give away answers. Missing three-hub validation means items slip into exams without proper USMLE mapping, breaking coverage tracking.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] POST /api/blueprints/[id]/assemble triggers assembly for a finalized blueprint
- [ ] Algorithm selects exactly blueprint.total_items items from the approved pool
- [ ] Bloom distribution matches blueprint within +/- 1 item per level
- [ ] USMLE system proportions match blueprint within +/- 2 items per system
- [ ] Difficulty distribution matches blueprint within +/- 1 item per band
- [ ] Equity floor met: >= blueprint.equity_floor fraction of items feature underrepresented scenarios
- [ ] Item proximity: no two items covering the same SubConcept within 3 positions
- [ ] Every selected item connects all three hubs (SubConcept + SLO + USMLE_Subtopic) — D06
- [ ] Assembly fails explicitly with specific constraint violations if pool is insufficient
- [ ] Assembly result is persisted to Supabase (exam_assemblies table) with item ordering
- [ ] Blueprint status updated to 'assembled' after successful assembly
- [ ] API returns 400 if blueprint is not in 'finalized' status
- [ ] API returns 409 if blueprint already has an assembly (must archive old one first)

| Rule | What it means for this story |

| Rule 1 (C05) | neo4jQuery for reading candidate items from Neo4j (hub connections, metadata) |
| Rule 6 (G08) | Assembly result written to Supabase first, then Neo4j sync of exam edges |

## Schema changes
```sql
-- Exam assemblies table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exam_assemblies (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  blueprint_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES blueprints(id),
  course_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES courses(id),
  institution_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES institutions(id),
  assembled_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id),
  total_items INTEGER NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'deployed', 'archived')),
  constraint_report JSONB NOT NULL,  -- { bloom_actual: {...}, system_actual: {...}, equity_actual: 0.18 }
  seed INTEGER,  -- for reproducibility
  neo4j_synced_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  neo4j_sync_status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exam_assembly_items (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  assembly_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES exam_assemblies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  item_id UUID NOT NULL,  -- FK to assessment_items
  position INTEGER NOT NULL,  -- 1-indexed ordering
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE(assembly_id, position),
  UNIQUE(assembly_id, item_id)
);

ALTER TABLE exam_assemblies ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE exam_assembly_items ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE POLICY exam_assemblies_faculty_policy ON exam_assemblies
  FOR ALL
  USING (institution_id = (SELECT institution_id FROM profiles WHERE id = auth.uid()))
  WITH CHECK (institution_id = (SELECT institution_id FROM profiles WHERE id = auth.uid()));

CREATE POLICY exam_assembly_items_faculty_policy ON exam_assembly_items
  FOR ALL
  USING (assembly_id IN (SELECT id FROM exam_assemblies WHERE institution_id = (SELECT institution_id FROM profiles WHERE id = auth.uid())))
  WITH CHECK (assembly_id IN (SELECT id FROM exam_assemblies WHERE institution_id = (SELECT institution_id FROM profiles WHERE id = auth.uid())));

-- After adding: pnpm db:types
```

## Neo4j edges created/traversed
| Edge | From -> To | Properties | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| COVERS | AssessmentItem -> SubConcept | — | Three-hub check |
| ALIGNS_TO | AssessmentItem -> SLO | — | Three-hub check |
| MAPPED_TO | AssessmentItem -> USMLE_Subtopic | — | Three-hub check + system mapping |
| BELONGS_TO | USMLE_Subtopic -> USMLE_System | — | System aggregation |
| INCLUDED_IN | AssessmentItem -> ExamAssembly | position: int | Created after assembly (Neo4j sync) |

## Inngest event context
None — synchronous API endpoint. Assembly runs in-request (pool size bounded by course items, typically < 500).

## API contract
```
POST /api/blueprints/[id]/assemble
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Request: { seed?: number }  // optional seed for reproducibility
Response: {
  data: {
    assembly_id: string,
    blueprint_id: string,
    total_items: number,
    items: Array<{ item_id: string, position: number, bloom: number, system: string, difficulty: string }>,
    constraint_report: {
      bloom_actual: Record<string, number>,
      bloom_target: Record<string, number>,
      system_actual: Record<string, number>,
      system_target: Record<string, number>,
      difficulty_actual: Record<string, number>,
      equity_actual: number,
      equity_target: number,
      all_constraints_met: boolean
    }
  },
  error: null
}
Error: {
  data: null,
  error: {
    code: 'INSUFFICIENT_POOL' | 'BLUEPRINT_NOT_FINALIZED' | 'ALREADY_ASSEMBLED' | 'FORBIDDEN',
    message: string,
    violations?: string[]  // specific constraints that couldn't be met
  }
}
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// features/coverage-blueprint/services/ExamAssemblyService.ts
import { neo4jQuery } from '@journey/neo4j/client'  // Rule 1
import { createServerClient } from '@journey/db/server'
import type { Row } from '@journey/db/client'

interface AssemblyConstraints {
  bloom_distribution: Record<string, number>
  system_proportions: Record<string, number>
  difficulty_distribution: Record<string, number>
  equity_floor: number
  total_items: number
  proximity_window: number  // default 3
}

interface CandidateItem {
  id: string
  bloom_level: number
  system_code: string
  difficulty: string
  subconcept_ids: string[]  // for proximity check
  has_equity_tag: boolean
  has_all_three_hubs: boolean  // D06 — must be true
}

export class ExamAssemblyService {
  private readonly PROXIMITY_WINDOW = 3

  async assemble(blueprintId: string, seed?: number): Promise<AssemblyResult> {
    // 1. Load blueprint from Supabase
    const supabase = createServerClient()
    const { data: blueprint } = await supabase
      .from('blueprints')
      .select('*')
      .eq('id', blueprintId)
      .single()

    // 2. Fetch candidate pool from Neo4j (Rule 1)
    const candidates = await this.fetchCandidatePool(blueprint!.course_id)

    // 3. Filter: only items with all three hubs (D06)
    const eligible = candidates.filter(c => c.has_all_three_hubs)

    // 4. Greedy bin-pack selection
    const selected = this.greedyBinPack(eligible, {
      bloom_distribution: blueprint!.bloom_distribution,
      system_proportions: blueprint!.system_proportions,
      difficulty_distribution: blueprint!.difficulty_distribution,
      equity_floor: blueprint!.equity_floor,
      total_items: blueprint!.total_items,
      proximity_window: this.PROXIMITY_WINDOW
    }, seed)

    // 5. Write to Supabase FIRST (Rule 6)
    // 6. Sync to Neo4j SECOND (failure logged, never blocks)
    return selected
  }

  private greedyBinPack(
    candidates: CandidateItem[],
    constraints: AssemblyConstraints,
    seed?: number
  ): SelectedItem[] {
    // Deterministic shuffle with seed for reproducibility
    // Greedy selection: pick item that best fills the most-underfilled constraint bin
    // Proximity check: skip if same SubConcept within proximity_window positions
    // Backtrack up to 5 times if stuck
  }
}
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E06/E06-S04.api.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'

const BASE = process.env.BASE_URL ?? 'http://localhost:3000'

test('Acceptance: assembly produces exactly total_items', async ({ request }) => {
  // Assumes a finalized blueprint exists (created in test setup)
  const res = await request.post(`${BASE}/api/blueprints/${process.env.TEST_BLUEPRINT_ID}/assemble`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` },
    data: { seed: 42 }
  })
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200)
  const { data } = await res.json()
  expect(data.items.length).toBe(data.total_items)
})

test('Acceptance: bloom distribution within tolerance', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.post(`${BASE}/api/blueprints/${process.env.TEST_BLUEPRINT_ID}/assemble`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` },
    data: { seed: 42 }
  })
  const { data } = await res.json()
  const report = data.constraint_report
  for (const [level, target] of Object.entries(report.bloom_target as Record<string, number>)) {
    const actual = report.bloom_actual[level] ?? 0
    expect(Math.abs(actual - target)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1)
  }
})

test('Acceptance: equity floor met', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.post(`${BASE}/api/blueprints/${process.env.TEST_BLUEPRINT_ID}/assemble`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` },
    data: { seed: 42 }
  })
  const { data } = await res.json()
  expect(data.constraint_report.equity_actual).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(
    data.constraint_report.equity_target
  )
})

test('Acceptance: proximity constraint respected', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.post(`${BASE}/api/blueprints/${process.env.TEST_BLUEPRINT_ID}/assemble`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` },
    data: { seed: 42 }
  })
  const { data } = await res.json()
  // Check no two items with same subconcept within 3 positions
  // (would need subconcept data in response — verify in integration test)
  expect(data.constraint_report.all_constraints_met).toBe(true)
})

test('Acceptance: same seed produces same assembly', async ({ request }) => {
  const res1 = await request.post(`${BASE}/api/blueprints/${process.env.TEST_BLUEPRINT_ID}/assemble`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` },
    data: { seed: 42 }
  })
  // Archive first assembly, then reassemble
  const res2 = await request.post(`${BASE}/api/blueprints/${process.env.TEST_BLUEPRINT_ID}/assemble`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` },
    data: { seed: 42 }
  })
  const { data: d1 } = await res1.json()
  const { data: d2 } = await res2.json()
  const ids1 = d1.items.map((i: any) => i.item_id)
  const ids2 = d2.items.map((i: any) => i.item_id)
  expect(ids1).toEqual(ids2)
})

test('Negative: non-finalized blueprint returns 400', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.post(`${BASE}/api/blueprints/${process.env.TEST_DRAFT_BLUEPRINT_ID}/assemble`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` },
    data: {}
  })
  expect(res.status()).toBe(400)
  const { error } = await res.json()
  expect(error.code).toBe('BLUEPRINT_NOT_FINALIZED')
})

test('Negative: insufficient pool returns error with violations', async ({ request }) => {
  // Use a blueprint with impossible constraints (e.g., 1000 items)
  const res = await request.post(`${BASE}/api/blueprints/${process.env.TEST_IMPOSSIBLE_BLUEPRINT_ID}/assemble`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` },
    data: {}
  })
  expect(res.status()).toBe(400)
  const { error } = await res.json()
  expect(error.code).toBe('INSUFFICIENT_POOL')
  expect(error.violations).toBeDefined()
  expect(error.violations.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
})
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS exam_assembly_items CASCADE; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS exam_assemblies CASCADE;` then `pnpm db:types`
2. Neo4j: `MATCH ()-[r:INCLUDED_IN]->() DELETE r` (remove any assembly edges)
3. Remove files: `rm features/coverage-blueprint/services/ExamAssemblyService.ts app/api/blueprints/\[id\]/assemble/route.ts`
4. `git stash && git checkout develop`
